faqs.question: What documents are required for RERA agent registration?
faqs.answer: Usually a photograph, an authenticated PAN copy, authenticated address proof of your place of business, income tax returns for the three preceding years (or a declaration if exempt) and business details. Firms add their partnership deed, LLP agreement or MOA/AOA and partners' photos. UP and Maharashtra also need a training certificate.

faqs.question: Is RERA registration mandatory for real estate agents?
faqs.answer: Yes. Section 9(1) of the RERA Act, 2016 says no agent may facilitate the sale or purchase of any plot, apartment or building in a project that must be registered unless the agent is registered with that state's RERA authority. Registration is state-wise and not transferable between states.

faqs.question: How do I apply for RERA agent registration online?
faqs.answer: Finish any training your state requires, open the state RERA portal, sign up as an individual or firm, fill the agent form, upload documents, pay the fee, answer any queries and download your certificate. HARERA Gurugram also asks for one printed set of the form and documents.

faqs.question: What is the RERA agent registration fee?
faqs.answer: It depends on the state. The UP RERA rules set ₹25,000 for individuals and ₹2,50,000 for others. HARERA Gurugram lists ₹50,000 and ₹2,50,000. MahaRERA lists ₹10,000 and ₹1,00,000 plus GST. Confirm the current fee on your state portal before paying.

faqs.question: How long is RERA agent registration valid and how is it renewed?
faqs.answer: MahaRERA registration is valid for five years. The UP rules as published give ten years for the first registration and five for each renewal, and ask you to apply at least three months before expiry, with a ₹5,000 renewal fee for individuals. Follow the dates on your certificate.

faqs.question: Do I need training before RERA agent registration?
faqs.answer: In some states. UP RERA runs a four-day training programme with an exam, and its registration form opens only after the training certificate is uploaded. MahaRERA requires a Certificate of Competency for new registration and renewal. Check your own state portal's notices.

faqs.question: What are the advantages of RERA registration for an agent?
faqs.answer: You can legally sell registered projects and claim commission, developers will empanel you, your name appears on the authority's public list of agents, buyers can verify you, and you avoid the daily penalty for working unregistered under Section 62 of the Act.

faqs.question: What is the penalty for an agent working without RERA registration?
faqs.answer: Under Section 62 of the RERA Act, up to ₹10,000 for every day of default, which can add up to 5% of the cost of the plot, apartment or building whose sale was facilitated. Ignoring later orders brings further penalties under Sections 65 and 66.

faqs.question: Does one RERA agent registration work in every state?
faqs.answer: No. Each state or union territory registers agents separately. A UP RERA number covers Noida, Greater Noida, Lucknow and Kanpur, but selling a Gurugram project needs Haryana RERA registration and a Delhi project needs Delhi RERA registration.
